hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *config/eval_articles_data/*) printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"config/eval_articles_data is eval ground truth - edits require explicit operator approval. GT is never changed to chase a pipeline bug."}}';; esac

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.py) "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/.venv/bin/ruff check --fix --force-exclude "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/.venv/bin/ruff format --force-exclude "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1;; esac; exit 0
